emergency_remote_support.marketingCopy: When a system is down and nobody can work, waiting for a scheduled appointment isn't an option. MCT Emergency Remote Support is priority same-day remote support for down systems and urgent issues, with rapid response to get you back up without waiting. When something breaks and it's blocking work, we connect fast and start solving. This is the response for urgent problems that need immediate attention - get priority support and fast resolution.
bestFor: Businesses with an urgent system issue right now
Organizations that can't wait for a scheduled appointment
Companies with a down system or blocked workflow
Businesses that need priority remote response

emergency_on_site_visit.marketingCopy: Some failures can't be fixed remotely - the server room, the network closet, the physical hardware need a technician in the building. MCT Emergency On-Site Visit is priority on-site response for situations requiring hands-on work, with fast dispatch when your issue needs someone there. When the problem is physical or network-level and remote access isn't possible, we dispatch a technician to your location to resolve it. This is the emergency response for issues that require in-person hands-on service.
bestFor: Businesses with an issue that requires hands-on work
Organizations where remote access isn't possible
Companies with a physical or network-level failure
Businesses that need a technician dispatched fast
customerOutcomes: Hands-on help when remote isn't possible

email_compromise_response.marketingCopy: A compromised email account is one of the most urgent threats a business faces - attackers send scams to your contacts, access sensitive mail, and set up forwarding to keep reading your messages. MCT Email Compromise Response is an immediate response service to contain and remediate a compromised email account: securing it, revoking attacker access, removing forwarding rules, and preventing further damage. When you suspect or confirm an email breach, we act immediately to contain it, clean it up, and harden it against recurrence.
bestFor: Businesses that suspect or confirm a compromised email account
Organizations that need fast containment of an email breach
Companies that want forwarding and attacker access removed
Businesses that want to harden email after a compromise
whatIsIncluded: Immediate containment of the compromised account
Removal of forwarding rules and attacker access
customerOutcomes: A compromised email account contained fast

ransomware_first_response.marketingCopy: When ransomware hits, every hour matters - systems encrypted, backups questioned, business operations at stake. MCT Ransomware First Response is an immediate incident response for ransomware: isolating systems, preserving evidence, and guiding recovery. When ransomware strikes, we act fast to contain the spread, preserve evidence for insurance and law enforcement, and coordinate your recovery path. This is the first-response service for a ransomware event - the immediate containment and guidance that limits damage.
bestFor: Businesses experiencing a ransomware event
Organizations that need immediate containment
Companies that need evidence preserved for insurance
Businesses that need guided recovery coordination
customerOutcomes: Ransomware contained fast to limit spread
Evidence preserved for insurance and authorities

MCT Website Down Emergency is fast response to restore a down website: diagnosing whether it's a host issue, configuration, or an attack, and getting your site back online. When your site goes down, we respond quickly to identify the cause and restore service. This is emergency response for your website - fast diagnosis and restoration when downtime is costing you business.

Organizations losing customers during downtime
Companies that need fast diagnosis and restoration
Businesses that want to prevent a repeat outage

When your network fails, we respond quickly to identify the fault and restore service. computer_won_t_boot_support.marketingCopy: When a computer won't boot, important work can feel locked inside it - and knowing whether the data is recoverable or the drive is failing matters fast. MCT Computer Won't Boot Support is diagnostic and recovery support for computers that won't start: determining the cause, recovering data where possible, and getting the device working again. We diagnose why the computer won't boot, attempt data recovery, and restore it to working condition. This is the support service for a computer that won't start up.

Organizations worried about data on the device
Companies that need diagnosis and recovery
Businesses that need the device working again
whatIsIncluded: Diagnosis of the boot failure cause
customerOutcomes: A clear diagnosis of the boot failure
A backup plan to prevent future loss

MCT Data Recovery Coordination is expert coordination for urgent data recovery: assessing the situation, recommending the right approach, and working with professional recovery services when needed. We coordinate the recovery effort - evaluating recovery options, avoiding actions that worsen the situation, and managing professional recovery when the stakes are high. This is the service for getting important data back.

Organizations facing a failed drive or deletion

Businesses with high-stakes data that must be recovered
whatIsIncluded: Immediate assessment of the data loss

Restore assistance once data is recovered
customerOutcomes: An expert coordinated the recovery effort

Recovery handled with minimal further risk

When a critical account is locked or inaccessible, we work fast to restore access safely - balancing speed with security verification. This is the emergency service for regaining control of an account that blocks business.
